scientific_integrity: General analytical proof supplemented by finite enumeration. The source four-item counterexample is acknowledged prior art, not a new example.
scientific_limitations: Two agents; complete good allocations; pair complements given by respective perfect matchings; welfare unit-valued completed pairs. Does not claim analogous results for overlapping pairs, more agents, nonunit weights or stronger fairness. Literature novelty remains subject to independent scrutiny.
title: A zero-or-one EF1 welfare deficit for complementary perfect-matchings
